This template is used for citing adventures and stories in the various [[Wizards of the Coast]] RPG sourcebooks. 

==Usage==
Place the following code on the page and replace the "issue number" and "story name" with the appropriate information.
 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>WizCite|book=BOOK NAME|story=''STORY NAME''|sformatted=''FORMATTED STORY NAME''}}

For example:
*<code><nowiki>{{WizCite|story=Shadows of Coruscant|book=Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook}}</nowiki></code>
results in:
*{{WizCite|story=Shadows of Coruscant|book=Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook}}
